home.title: Home
auth.forbidden: You do not have permission to access this page.
auth.too.many.requests: Too many login attempts. Please try again later.
auth.google.cancelled: Google sign-in was cancelled. You can try again or use your password.
auth.google.failed: Google sign-in failed. Please try again.
auth.google.conflict: Sign in to your existing account to continue, then choose Connect Google on the next screen. Accounts are never linked automatically.
auth.account.title: Profile
auth.profile.avatar.title: Profile photo
auth.profile.avatar.description: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image up to 5 MB. It will be cropped to a square thumbnail. Your upload replaces your Google photo; removing it restores the Google photo when available.
auth.profile.avatar.invalid: Choose a valid JPEG, PNG or WebP image up to 5 MB.
auth.profile.avatar.failed: Unable to prepare the profile photo. Please try again.
auth.profile.providers.unknown: Sign-in method status is unavailable. Please reload or contact an administrator.
auth.profile.google.connected: You can sign in with Google. Google manages that account's password and security.
auth.profile.password.description: Confirm your current password to choose a new one. This signs out all sessions, including this one.
auth.profile.password.external: This account uses Google sign-in and has no local password. Manage your password in your Google Account.
auth.profile.password.changed: Password changed. All sessions have been signed out. Log in with your new password.
auth.profile.password.incorrect: Your current password is incorrect. Please try again.
auth.google.link.description: Confirm your current password to connect Google to this account. This will not switch your signed-in account.
auth.google.link.continue: You are signed in. Connect Google to use either method for this account, or continue without connecting.
auth.google.link.linked: Google is now connected to your account.
auth.google.link.cancelled: Connecting Google was cancelled. Your account is unchanged.
auth.google.link.conflict: This Google identity is already connected to another account. No accounts were merged.
auth.google.link.failed: Unable to connect Google. Your signed-in account has not changed. Please try again.
auth.google.link.configuration: Google sign-in configuration is incomplete or invalid. Ask an administrator to check the Google OAuth settings and shared callback URL.
auth.google.link.reauthenticate: Unable to confirm your current password or session. Try again, or sign in again.
auth.email.invalid: Enter a valid email address (up to 128 characters)
auth.full.name: Full name
auth.full.name.invalid: Full name must be at most 256 characters
auth.signup.check.email: Check your inbox (and spam folder). Confirm your email address within 24 hours before logging in.
auth.signup.email.exists: This email is already registered. Log in, or retry an unconfirmed signup with the same password.
auth.signup.too.many.requests: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
auth.confirm.title: Confirm email address
auth.confirm.description: Confirm your email address to activate your account.
auth.confirm.success: Email confirmed. You can now log in.
auth.confirm.invalid: This confirmation link is invalid, expired, or already used. Sign up again with the same email and password to request a new link.
auth.recover.title: Forgot password?
auth.recover.description: Enter your account email address to request a password reset link.
auth.recover.sent: If an active account exists for this email address, a reset link has been sent. Check your inbox and spam folder. The link expires in one hour.
auth.reset.title: Reset password
auth.reset.success: Password reset. All previous sessions have been signed out. Log in with your new password.
auth.reset.invalid: This reset link is invalid, expired, or already used. Request a new link.
